_comment: Atlas per-project config — copy to atlas.config.json in the project root and edit. Every field is optional; defaults are tier 0 and dry-run ON.

autonomy._comment: tier: 0 advise-only · 1 act-and-report on reversible work · 2 open real PRs (merge only on green CI) · 3 scheduled autonomous maintenance. dry_run: while true, action-taking scripts print and log what they WOULD do and change nothing.

thresholds._comment: Used by pulse.js anomaly detection and decide.js (growth-engine.md's decision tree).
